title: the DATA_BATCH sample-info loop guards on a user preference whose default of 0 disables the guard entirely, so the write runs off arrays sized sample_info_max
object: sample_info_flags and sample_info_length, two consecutive chunks of the PACKET pool sized sample_info_max entries each
lifetime_ender: NONE -- the object is alive throughout. This is a SPATIAL row.
shape: a gate disabled by its own default: `rtps_max_batch_samples_dissected > 0 && count >= rtps_max_batch_samples_dissected` cannot fire when the preference is 0, which is the shipped default, so nothing bounds the counter while the arrays stay sample_info_max long
allocator_layer: wmem, a chunk the BLOCK or BLOCK_FAST allocator carved from a block g_malloc handed out. An inner allocator carved the crossed region, so under this inventory's axis -- WHO ALLOCATED THE OBJECT -- this row IS NESTED.
nested_why: an inner allocator (wmem) carved the crossed region out of a larger block it had itself obtained from g_malloc, so under this inventory's axis -- WHO ALLOCATED THE OBJECT -- this row IS NESTED.
fidelity: real allocator, model consumer. SAMPLE_INFO_MAX is reduced from 1024 to 8. The defect is that NOTHING bounds the counter, so the array's length changes how many iterations it takes to leave, not whether it leaves. The preference is kept at its real default of 0, because that value IS the defect, and the case asserts both that the pin's guard does not fire and that the fix's guard would.
live_proof: read from the PINNED source, keyed on the identifier: v4.6.8:epan/dissectors/packet-rtps.c contains the pre-fix guard `rtps_max_batch_samples_dissected > 0 &&` 1 time and the fixed `(unsigned)sample_info_max` 0 times. Two-sided. LIVE AT THE PIN.
distinguishing: THE ROW THAT FILLS AN EMPTY CELL: the inventory recorded the nested-spatial cell as having no LIVE upstream defect, and this one is live at v4.6.8. It is also the only row in this corpus whose defect is a guard that CANNOT FIRE in the shipped configuration rather than a guard that is absent or miscomputed -- the preference's default of 0 short-circuits it. The fix's own comment says so: guarding on sample_info_max 'keeps the 0 case bounded too'.

native-detect.oracle: MEASURED 2026-10-09, results/2026-10-09-native-asan/: **NO ASan REPORT** on the buggy arm, which printed VERDICT DEFECT-REPRODUCED, so the defective access ran and ASan did not see it. The fixed arm exits 0 with VERDICT FIXED and no report. Built with the port's own allocator library under the same sanitizer (cc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0; -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O0; wmem and the port built with the same flags). Positive controls in the same run: `asan-control past 402653184` -> heap-buffer-overflow; `asan-control uaf 402653184` -> heap-use-after-free -- so ASan reports on a heap block the size of this corpus's arena, and the silence is the arena: one malloc'd block, carved and recycled without free(). Predicted before the run (b64cd18b85d0); the arm was previously 'not written'.
